Why Aviation

Mindset

To operate with the mindset, discipline, and skill required for excellence in aviation, backed by a 4.0 GPA and a perfect 100% on the FAA Commercial Knowledge Exam. That means preparing thoroughly, communicating clearly, and holding the same high standard on the ground and in the air.

Teaching

As an aeronautics tutor I explain complex ACS knowledge concepts using real-world examples and analogies, and I adapt to how each student learns so everyone understands the material.

Teamwork and leadership grew through the National Intercollegiate Flying Association, a safe but competitive environment.
